title: Channels
description: The Instagram accounts this workspace answers for. Automations and the inbox use them.

connected.title: Instagram account connected
connected.description: Comments and messages to it can now start automations.

notConfigured.title: Instagram is not set up on this installation
notConfigured.body: The administrator must configure the Meta app before accounts can be connected — see {doc}.

sandbox.title: Sandbox mode
sandbox.body: No real Instagram is used. Connecting creates a practice account, and “Simulate an event” pretends someone commented or sent a message, so you can try automations safely.

memberNote.title: Only workspace owners and admins can connect or disconnect accounts
memberNote.body: You can see every connected account here. Ask an admin to add one or to reconnect one that stopped working.

states.loadFailedDescription: Nothing was changed. Connected accounts keep working.

empty.title: No Instagram accounts yet
empty.description: Connect the account people comment on and write to. Conversa then reads its comments and messages and answers through your automations.

requirements.professional: The account must be an Instagram professional account (Business or Creator).
requirements.permissions: When Instagram asks, allow Conversa to read comments and to send messages.
requirements.admin: You need to be able to sign in to that Instagram account.

empty.memberDescription: Ask a workspace owner or admin to connect the account people comment on and write to.

noEvents.title: No events from Instagram yet
noEvents.body: This account was connected a while ago and Instagram has sent nothing for it. Is your Meta app in Live mode? Is Allow access to messages on in the Instagram app?
noEvents.askAdmin: This account was connected a while ago and Instagram has sent nothing for it. Ask the person who set up this installation to check that the Meta app is in Live mode, and check that Allow access to messages is on in the Instagram app.

card.needsReauth: Instagram stopped accepting this account's access. Its automations are paused until someone reconnects it.
card.disconnectedNote: Conversa no longer has access to this account. Reconnect it to use it again.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect @{username}?
disconnectDialog.description: Conversa forgets this account's access and pauses every automation that uses it. Contacts and history stay. You can reconnect it later.

simulateDialog.title: Simulate an event on @{username}
simulateDialog.description: Pretend someone interacted with this practice account. Matching automations run as they would with a real one.
simulateDialog.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, dots and underscores, without the @.
simulateDialog.mediaEmpty: This account has no posts to comment on.
simulateDialog.mediaRequired: Choose the post the comment is on.
simulateDialog.doneDescription: Matching automations run in a few seconds. Check the activity page.
